definitions.explanation: To decrease effort, cost, or time.

examples.japanese: {詳細|しょうさい}は{省|はぶ}く。
{説明|せつめい}を{省|はぶ}いてもいいですか。
{長|なが}いので{途中|とちゅう}を{省|はぶ}いて{話|はな}します。
examples.english: Since it's long, I'll leave out the middle part and tell you.

examples.japanese: {無駄|むだ}を{省|はぶ}いて{時間|じかん}を{節約|せつやく}する。
examples.english: To save time by eliminating waste.

examples.japanese: この{道具|どうぐ}を{使|つか}えば{手間|てま}が{省|はぶ}ける。
examples.english: Using this tool will save you the trouble.
examples.notes: {省|はぶ}ける is the potential form.

notes:
{省|はぶ}く means to omit, leave out, or reduce unnecessary elements.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle

TWO NUANCES:
1. To omit/leave out: {詳細|しょうさい}を{省|はぶ}く (omit details)
2. To save/reduce: {手間|てま}を{省|はぶ}く (save effort)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手間|てま}を{省|はぶ}く: to save effort/time
- {無駄|むだ}を{省|はぶ}く: to eliminate waste
- {説明|せつめい}を{省|はぶ}く: to skip explanations
- {経費|けいひ}を{省|はぶ}く: to cut expenses
- {時間|じかん}を{省|はぶ}く: to save time

RELATED WORDS:
- {省略|しょうりゅく}する: to abbreviate, omit (more formal)
- {省|はぶ}ける: can be omitted (potential form)
- {手抜|てぬ}き: cutting corners
